package domain

import (
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
	"math"
	"reflect"
	"sort"
	"strings"
	"time"
	"unicode/utf8"
)

// Explicit bounded whitelist of Student observations. No evidence bodies,
// answers, prompts, source code or private validation fields exist here.
const HybridSnapshotSchema = "student-planning-snapshot.v1"
const MaximumHybridSnapshotResponseBytes = 128 << 20
const MaximumHybridSnapshotRequestBytes = 2 << 20

type HybridTargetRef struct {
	Type    TargetType `json:"type"`
	Key     string     `json:"key"`
	Version string     `json:"version,omitempty"`
}

func hybridTargetIdentity(t HybridTargetRef) string {
	return string(t.Type) + "\x00" + t.Key + "\x00" + t.Version
}
func sortHybridTargetRefs(in []HybridTargetRef) []HybridTargetRef {
	out := append([]HybridTargetRef{}, in...)
	sortHybridTargets(out)
	return out
}

type HybridSnapshotTrigger struct {
	Kind          string `json:"kind"`
	Reason        string `json:"reason"`
	CorrelationID string `json:"correlation_id,omitempty"`
}

type HybridSnapshotRequest struct {
	Targets        []HybridTargetRef     `json:"targets"`
	TriggerContext HybridSnapshotTrigger `json:"trigger_context"`
}

type HybridEvidenceReference struct {
	StudentID             string          `json:"-"`
	SourceKind            string          `json:"source_kind"`
	SurfaceClassification string          `json:"surface_classification,omitempty"`
	EvidenceID            string          `json:"evidence_id"`
	LearningActionID      string          `json:"learning_action_id,omitempty"`
	TaskID                string          `json:"task_id,omitempty"`
	TaskInstanceID        string          `json:"task_instance_id,omitempty"`
	TaskRevisionID        string          `json:"task_revision_id,omitempty"`
	SubmissionID          string          `json:"submission_id,omitempty"`
	Target                HybridTargetRef `json:"target"`
	EvidenceClass         string          `json:"evidence_class"`
	Outcome               string          `json:"outcome"`
	SupportContext        string          `json:"support_context"`
	Kind                  string          `json:"kind"`
	HintsUsed             int             `json:"hints_used"`
	MaxHintLevel          *int            `json:"max_hint_level,omitempty"`
	InterventionUsed      bool            `json:"intervention_used"`
	TeacherPolicyVersion  string          `json:"teacher_policy_version"`
	MasteryPolicyVersion  string          `json:"mastery_policy_version"`
	ReceiptHash           string          `json:"receipt_hash,omitempty"`
	OccurredAt            time.Time       `json:"occurred_at"`
}

type HybridCourseActionBinding struct {
	StudentID          string            `json:"-"`
	LearningActionID   string            `json:"learning_action_id"`
	AnswerID           string            `json:"answer_id"`
	TaskID             string            `json:"task_id"`
	LearningPathItemID string            `json:"learning_path_item_id"`
	RequirementID      string            `json:"requirement_id"`
	LifecycleStatus    string            `json:"lifecycle_status"`
	AnswerStatus       int               `json:"answer_status"`
	LearningTargets    []HybridTargetRef `json:"learning_targets"`
	OpenedAt           time.Time         `json:"opened_at"`
	ClosedAt           *time.Time        `json:"closed_at,omitempty"`
}

type HybridSnapshotProfile struct {
	ProfileVersion         string   `json:"profile_version"`
	OwnerVersion           int64    `json:"owner_version"`
	DirectionCode          string   `json:"direction_code"`
	SelfAssessedExperience string   `json:"self_assessed_experience"`
	KnownStacks            []string `json:"known_stacks"`
	DesiredStacks          []string `json:"desired_stacks"`
	GoalCode               string   `json:"goal_code"`
	PreferredLanguage      string   `json:"preferred_language"`
	WeeklyMinutes          int      `json:"weekly_minutes"`
	PreferredPace          string   `json:"preferred_pace"`
}

type HybridSnapshotPath struct {
	ID                     string               `json:"learning_path_id"`
	CourseID               string               `json:"course_id"`
	GoalCode               string               `json:"goal_code"`
	CourseFingerprint      string               `json:"course_fingerprint"`
	PolicyVersion          string               `json:"policy_version"`
	PlannerPolicyVersion   string               `json:"planner_policy_version"`
	Status                 string               `json:"status"`
	IsPrimary              bool                 `json:"is_primary"`
	IsSelected             bool                 `json:"is_selected"`
	Version                int64                `json:"path_version"`
	JourneyVersion         int64                `json:"journey_version"`
	SelectedLearningPathID string               `json:"selected_learning_path_id,omitempty"`
	Items                  []HybridSnapshotItem `json:"items"`
}

type HybridSnapshotItem struct {
	ID                 string                    `json:"learning_path_item_id"`
	LessonRevisionID   string                    `json:"lesson_revision_id,omitempty"`
	ReferenceType      string                    `json:"reference_type"`
	ReferenceID        string                    `json:"reference_id"`
	Position           int                       `json:"position"`
	Status             LearningPathItemStatus    `json:"status"`
	Targets            []HybridTargetRef         `json:"targets"`
	FrozenRequirements []HybridLessonRequirement `json:"frozen_requirements"`
}

type HybridSnapshotMastery struct {
	Target                  HybridTargetRef `json:"target"`
	State                   MasteryState    `json:"state"`
	MasteryScore            float64         `json:"mastery_score"`
	Confidence              float64         `json:"confidence"`
	IndependentSuccessCount int             `json:"independent_success_count"`
	AssistedSuccessCount    int             `json:"assisted_success_count"`
	FailureCount            int             `json:"failure_count"`
	EvidenceCount           int             `json:"evidence_count"`
	PolicyVersion           string          `json:"policy_version"`
	LastSeenAt              *time.Time      `json:"last_seen_at,omitempty"`
	LastPracticedAt         *time.Time      `json:"last_practiced_at,omitempty"`
	LastFailedAt            *time.Time      `json:"last_failed_at,omitempty"`
}

type HybridSnapshotActivityFact struct {
	ItemID           string    `json:"learning_path_item_id"`
	RequirementID    string    `json:"requirement_id"`
	Type             string    `json:"type"`
	SourceID         string    `json:"source_id"`
	SourceRevisionID string    `json:"source_revision_id,omitempty"`
	FactID           string    `json:"fact_id"`
	OccurredAt       time.Time `json:"occurred_at"`
}

type HybridPracticeBinding struct {
	LearningActionID                string            `json:"learning_action_id"`
	TaskInstanceID                  string            `json:"task_instance_id"`
	TaskRevisionID                  string            `json:"task_revision_id"`
	TaskRevisionDigest              string            `json:"task_revision_digest"`
	LearningPathID                  string            `json:"learning_path_id"`
	LearningPathItemID              string            `json:"learning_path_item_id,omitempty"`
	RequirementID                   string            `json:"requirement_id,omitempty"`
	SurfaceClassification           string            `json:"surface_classification"`
	LifecycleStatus                 string            `json:"lifecycle_status"`
	LearningTargets                 []HybridTargetRef `json:"learning_targets"`
	LearningPathVersionReservation  int64             `json:"learning_path_version_at_reservation"`
	LearningPathPositionReservation int               `json:"learning_path_position_at_reservation"`
}

type HybridSnapshotSignal struct {
	Status     string    `json:"status"`
	Value      *struct{} `json:"value"`
	ReasonCode string    `json:"reason_code"`
}

type HybridSnapshotAvailability struct {
	EvidenceQuality     HybridSnapshotSignal `json:"evidence_quality"`
	Stability           HybridSnapshotSignal `json:"stability"`
	RuntimeHold         HybridSnapshotSignal `json:"runtime_hold"`
	AutomaticAdaptation HybridSnapshotSignal `json:"automatic_adaptation"`
	StudentPinning      HybridSnapshotSignal `json:"student_pinning"`
}

type HybridSnapshotReferences struct {
	LearnerRef     string `json:"learner_ref"`
	MasteryRef     string `json:"mastery_ref"`
	GoalRef        string `json:"goal_ref"`
	ConstraintsRef string `json:"constraints_ref"`
	SnapshotRef    string `json:"snapshot_ref"`
}

type HybridPlanningSnapshot struct {
	Schema           string                          `json:"schema"`
	StudentID        string                          `json:"student_id"`
	LearningPathID   string                          `json:"learning_path_id"`
	CapturedAt       time.Time                       `json:"captured_at"`
	TriggerContext   HybridSnapshotTrigger           `json:"trigger_context"`
	References       HybridSnapshotReferences        `json:"references"`
	RequestedTargets []HybridTargetRef               `json:"requested_targets"`
	Profile          HybridSnapshotProfile           `json:"profile"`
	Path             HybridSnapshotPath              `json:"path"`
	Mastery          []HybridSnapshotMastery         `json:"mastery"`
	Evidence         []HybridEvidenceReference       `json:"evidence"`
	ActivityFacts    []HybridSnapshotActivityFact    `json:"activity_facts"`
	CourseBindings   []HybridCourseActionBinding     `json:"course_bindings"`
	PracticeBindings []HybridPracticeBinding         `json:"practice_bindings"`
	Availability     HybridSnapshotAvailability      `json:"availability"`
	PendingIntent    *HybridLearningIntentProjection `json:"pending_intent,omitempty"`
}

type HybridLessonSourceReference struct {
	ID         string `json:"id"`
	RevisionID string `json:"revision_id,omitempty"`
}
type HybridLessonRequirement struct {
	ID              string                      `json:"requirement_id"`
	ActivityID      string                      `json:"activity_id"`
	Type            string                      `json:"type"`
	Required        bool                        `json:"required"`
	SourceReference HybridLessonSourceReference `json:"source_reference"`
	Satisfied       bool                        `json:"satisfied"`
}

type HybridEvidenceQuality string

const (
	HybridQualityUnknown     HybridEvidenceQuality = "UNKNOWN"
	HybridQualityObservation HybridEvidenceQuality = "OBSERVATION"
	HybridQualityAssessment  HybridEvidenceQuality = "ASSESSMENT"
	HybridQualityExecution   HybridEvidenceQuality = "EXECUTION"
	HybridQualityProject     HybridEvidenceQuality = "PROJECT"
)

type HybridMasteryStability string

const (
	HybridStabilityUnstable   HybridMasteryStability = "UNSTABLE"
	HybridStabilityDeveloping HybridMasteryStability = "DEVELOPING"
	HybridStabilityStable     HybridMasteryStability = "STABLE"
)

// ClassifyHybridEvidence uses only authoritative frozen provenance. Teacher
// assistance is never objective evidence and unfamiliar provenance is UNKNOWN.
func ClassifyHybridEvidence(e HybridEvidenceReference) HybridEvidenceQuality {
	switch e.SourceKind {
	case "course_answer":
		switch e.EvidenceClass {
		case "knowledge_check":
			return HybridQualityAssessment
		case "application":
			return HybridQualityExecution
		}
	case "practice_v2", "practice_legacy":
		if e.EvidenceClass != "application" {
			return HybridQualityUnknown
		}
		switch e.SurfaceClassification {
		case "project":
			return HybridQualityProject
		case "practice":
			return HybridQualityExecution
		case "":
			if e.SourceKind == "practice_legacy" {
				return HybridQualityExecution
			}
		}
	}
	return HybridQualityUnknown
}

type HybridTargetSignal struct {
	Quality                    HybridEvidenceQuality
	Stability                  HybridMasteryStability
	IndependentApplications    int
	DistinctApplicationSources int
}

// DeriveHybridTargetSignal preserves Student's normalized application kind and
// task identity. IndependentSuccessCount includes quizzes and is not used here.
func DeriveHybridTargetSignal(m HybridSnapshotMastery, evidence []HybridEvidenceReference) HybridTargetSignal {
	result := HybridTargetSignal{Quality: HybridQualityUnknown, Stability: HybridStabilityUnstable}
	sources, seen := map[string]bool{}, map[string]bool{}
	unknown := false
	for _, e := range evidence {
		if e.Target != m.Target {
			continue
		}
		quality := ClassifyHybridEvidence(e)
		_, provenanceErr := normalizeHybridSnapshotEvidence(e, map[string]bool{hybridTargetIdentity(m.Target): true})
		if provenanceErr != nil {
			quality = HybridQualityUnknown
		}
		unknown = unknown || quality == HybridQualityUnknown
		if hybridQualityRank(quality) > hybridQualityRank(result.Quality) {
			result.Quality = quality
		}
		if e.Kind != "independent_application" || e.Outcome != "passed" || e.SupportContext != "independent" || e.HintsUsed != 0 || e.InterventionUsed {
			continue
		}
		source := e.TaskID
		if e.SourceKind == "practice_v2" || e.SourceKind == "practice_legacy" {
			source = e.TaskInstanceID
		}
		if source == "" || seen[e.SourceKind+":"+e.EvidenceID] || provenanceErr != nil {
			continue
		}
		seen[e.SourceKind+":"+e.EvidenceID] = true
		sources[source] = true
		result.IndependentApplications++
	}
	result.DistinctApplicationSources = len(sources)
	if unknown {
		result.Quality = HybridQualityUnknown
	}
	if result.IndependentApplications >= 2 && len(sources) >= 2 {
		result.Stability = HybridStabilityDeveloping
	}
	if result.IndependentApplications >= 3 && len(sources) >= 2 && m.State == MasteryMastered {
		result.Stability = HybridStabilityStable
	}
	return result
}

// DeriveHybridSnapshotTargetSignal also includes real theory-acknowledgement
// facts on this target. Exposure never becomes an objective application.
func DeriveHybridSnapshotTargetSignal(s HybridPlanningSnapshot, m HybridSnapshotMastery) HybridTargetSignal {
	result := DeriveHybridTargetSignal(m, s.Evidence)
	if result.Quality != HybridQualityUnknown {
		return result
	}
	for _, e := range s.Evidence {
		if e.Target == m.Target {
			return result
		}
	}
	for _, fact := range s.ActivityFacts {
		if fact.Type != "theory_acknowledged" {
			continue
		}
		for _, item := range s.Path.Items {
			if item.ID != fact.ItemID {
				continue
			}
			for _, target := range item.Targets {
				if target == m.Target {
					result.Quality = HybridQualityObservation
					return result
				}
			}
		}
	}
	return result
}
func hybridQualityRank(q HybridEvidenceQuality) int {
	switch q {
	case HybridQualityObservation:
		return 1
	case HybridQualityAssessment:
		return 2
	case HybridQualityExecution:
		return 3
	case HybridQualityProject:
		return 4
	}
	return 0
}
func hybridUUID(v string) bool {
	id, err := uuid.Parse(v)
	return err == nil && id != uuid.Nil && id.String() == v
}
func hybridDigest(v string) bool {
	if !strings.HasPrefix(v, "sha256:") || len(v) != 71 {
		return false
	}
	decoded, err := hex.DecodeString(v[7:])
	return err == nil && len(decoded) == 32 && strings.ToLower(v) == v
}
func hybridTargetValid(t HybridTargetRef) bool {
	return (t.Type == TargetConcept || t.Type == TargetCapability) && strings.TrimSpace(t.Key) == t.Key && t.Key != "" && len(t.Key) <= 255 && utf8.ValidString(t.Key) && len(t.Version) <= 128 && strings.TrimSpace(t.Version) == t.Version && utf8.ValidString(t.Version)
}
func NormalizeHybridSnapshotRequest(r HybridSnapshotRequest) (HybridSnapshotRequest, error) {
	if len(r.Targets) < 1 || len(r.Targets) > 500 || strings.TrimSpace(r.TriggerContext.Kind) == "" || strings.TrimSpace(r.TriggerContext.Reason) == "" || !utf8.ValidString(r.TriggerContext.Kind) || !utf8.ValidString(r.TriggerContext.Reason) || (r.TriggerContext.CorrelationID != "" && !hybridUUID(r.TriggerContext.CorrelationID)) {
		return HybridSnapshotRequest{}, ErrValidation
	}
	seen := map[string]bool{}
	for _, t := range r.Targets {
		if !hybridTargetValid(t) || seen[hybridTargetIdentity(t)] {
			return HybridSnapshotRequest{}, ErrValidation
		}
		seen[hybridTargetIdentity(t)] = true
	}
	raw, err := json.Marshal(r)
	if err != nil || len(raw) > MaximumHybridSnapshotRequestBytes {
		return HybridSnapshotRequest{}, ErrValidation
	}
	r.Targets = sortHybridTargetRefs(r.Targets)
	return r, nil
}

// Validation never repairs hashes, fills mastery, or invents missing provenance.
func ValidateHybridPlanningSnapshot(s HybridPlanningSnapshot, studentID, pathID string, request HybridSnapshotRequest) error {
	if s.RequestedTargets == nil || s.Mastery == nil || s.Evidence == nil || s.ActivityFacts == nil || s.CourseBindings == nil || s.PracticeBindings == nil {
		return ErrUpstreamInvalid
	}
	if s.Schema != HybridSnapshotSchema || !hybridUUID(studentID) || !hybridUUID(pathID) || s.StudentID != studentID || s.LearningPathID != pathID || s.Path.ID != pathID || !hybridUUID(s.Path.CourseID) || s.CapturedAt.IsZero() || !reflect.DeepEqual(s.RequestedTargets, request.Targets) || !reflect.DeepEqual(s.TriggerContext, request.TriggerContext) || s.Path.Version < 1 || s.Path.JourneyVersion < 1 || len(s.Path.Items) < 1 || len(s.Path.Items) > 500 || s.Path.GoalCode == "" || s.Path.CourseFingerprint == "" || s.Path.PolicyVersion != "student-learning-path-v1" || s.Path.PlannerPolicyVersion == "" || s.Profile.ProfileVersion != StudentPlanningProfileVersion || s.Profile.OwnerVersion < 1 {
		return ErrUpstreamInvalid
	}
	if _, err := NormalizeStudentPlanningProfile(StudentPlanningProfile{DirectionCode: s.Profile.DirectionCode, SelfAssessedExperience: s.Profile.SelfAssessedExperience, KnownStacks: s.Profile.KnownStacks, DesiredStacks: s.Profile.DesiredStacks, GoalCode: s.Profile.GoalCode, PreferredLanguage: s.Profile.PreferredLanguage, WeeklyMinutes: s.Profile.WeeklyMinutes, PreferredPace: s.Profile.PreferredPace, ProfileVersion: s.Profile.ProfileVersion}); err != nil {
		return ErrUpstreamInvalid
	}
	if !validLearningPathStatus(s.Path.Status) || s.Path.IsSelected != (s.Path.SelectedLearningPathID == pathID) || (s.Path.SelectedLearningPathID != "" && !hybridUUID(s.Path.SelectedLearningPathID)) {
		return ErrUpstreamInvalid
	}
	for _, ref := range []string{s.References.SnapshotRef, s.References.LearnerRef, s.References.MasteryRef, s.References.GoalRef, s.References.ConstraintsRef} {
		if !hybridDigest(ref) {
			return ErrUpstreamInvalid
		}
	}
	items := map[string]bool{}
	ready := 0
	for i, item := range s.Path.Items {
		if !hybridUUID(item.ID) || items[item.ID] || !hybridUUID(item.ReferenceID) || item.Position != i || (item.ReferenceType != "lesson" && item.ReferenceType != "practice") || !validLearningPathItemStatus(item.Status, true) || (item.LessonRevisionID != "" && (!hybridUUID(item.LessonRevisionID) || item.ReferenceType != "lesson")) {
			return ErrUpstreamInvalid
		}
		items[item.ID] = true
		if item.Status == LearningPathItemReady {
			ready++
		}
		for _, t := range item.Targets {
			if !hybridTargetValid(t) {
				return ErrUpstreamInvalid
			}
		}
	}
	if ready > 1 || len(s.Mastery) != len(request.Targets) {
		return ErrUpstreamInvalid
	}
	for i, m := range s.Mastery {
		if m.Target != request.Targets[i] || !validMasteryState(m.State) || m.PolicyVersion != StudentMasteryPolicyVersion || math.IsNaN(m.Confidence) || math.IsInf(m.Confidence, 0) || m.Confidence < 0 || m.Confidence > 1 || math.IsNaN(m.MasteryScore) || math.IsInf(m.MasteryScore, 0) || m.MasteryScore < 0 || m.MasteryScore > 1 || m.IndependentSuccessCount < 0 || m.AssistedSuccessCount < 0 || m.FailureCount < 0 || m.EvidenceCount < 0 || int64(m.IndependentSuccessCount)+int64(m.AssistedSuccessCount)+int64(m.FailureCount) != int64(m.EvidenceCount) {
			return ErrUpstreamInvalid
		}
	}
	for _, e := range s.Evidence {
		if !hybridUUID(e.EvidenceID) || !hybridTargetValid(e.Target) || e.MasteryPolicyVersion != StudentMasteryPolicyVersion || e.OccurredAt.IsZero() || e.TeacherPolicyVersion == "" || (e.EvidenceClass != "application" && e.EvidenceClass != "knowledge_check") || (e.Outcome != "passed" && e.Outcome != "failed") {
			return ErrUpstreamInvalid
		}
	}
	for _, b := range s.PracticeBindings {
		if !hybridUUID(b.TaskInstanceID) || !hybridUUID(b.TaskRevisionID) || !hybridUUID(b.LearningActionID) || b.LearningPathID != pathID || !hybridDigest(b.TaskRevisionDigest) || (b.LearningPathItemID != "" && !items[b.LearningPathItemID]) {
			return ErrUpstreamInvalid
		}
	}
	for _, signal := range []HybridSnapshotSignal{s.Availability.EvidenceQuality, s.Availability.Stability} {
		if signal.Status != "DERIVED_BY_PLANNER" || signal.Value != nil || signal.ReasonCode != "PLANNER_POLICY_HYBRID_V1" {
			return ErrUpstreamInvalid
		}
	}
	if s.PendingIntent != nil && ValidateHybridLearningIntentProjection(*s.PendingIntent, s) != nil {
		return ErrUpstreamInvalid
	}
	if err := validateHybridOwnerSemantics(s); err != nil {
		return ErrUpstreamInvalid
	}
	refs, err := HybridSnapshotReferencesFor(s)
	if err != nil || !reflect.DeepEqual(refs, s.References) {
		return ErrUpstreamInvalid
	}
	return nil
}

// A bounded local wire digest for jobs; applicability uses Student snapshot_ref.
func HybridSnapshotContentHash(s HybridPlanningSnapshot) (string, error) {
	raw, err := json.Marshal(s)
	if err != nil || len(raw) > MaximumHybridSnapshotResponseBytes {
		return "", ErrValidation
	}
	sum := sha256.Sum256(raw)
	return "sha256:" + hex.EncodeToString(sum[:]), nil
}
func HybridSnapshotTargets(s HybridPlanningSnapshot) []HybridTargetRef {
	byID := map[string]HybridTargetRef{}
	for _, item := range s.Path.Items {
		for _, target := range item.Targets {
			byID[hybridTargetIdentity(target)] = target
		}
	}
	for _, binding := range s.CourseBindings {
		for _, target := range binding.LearningTargets {
			byID[hybridTargetIdentity(target)] = target
		}
	}
	for _, binding := range s.PracticeBindings {
		for _, target := range binding.LearningTargets {
			byID[hybridTargetIdentity(target)] = target
		}
	}
	result := make([]HybridTargetRef, 0, len(byID))
	for _, t := range byID {
		result = append(result, t)
	}
	sort.Slice(result, func(i, j int) bool { return hybridTargetIdentity(result[i]) < hybridTargetIdentity(result[j]) })
	return result
}

func HybridSnapshotReferencesFor(s HybridPlanningSnapshot) (HybridSnapshotReferences, error) {
	// Marshal/parse creates an owned whitelist copy, so sorting the canonical
	// projections cannot mutate protected source models or response arrays.
	raw, err := json.Marshal(s)
	if err != nil || len(raw) > MaximumHybridSnapshotResponseBytes {
		return HybridSnapshotReferences{}, ErrValidation
	}
	var canonical HybridPlanningSnapshot
	if json.Unmarshal(raw, &canonical) != nil {
		return HybridSnapshotReferences{}, ErrValidation
	}
	sort.Strings(canonical.Profile.KnownStacks)
	sort.Strings(canonical.Profile.DesiredStacks)
	sortHybridCollections(&canonical)
	for i := range canonical.Path.Items {
		item := &canonical.Path.Items[i]
		sortHybridTargets(item.Targets)
		sort.Slice(item.FrozenRequirements, func(i, j int) bool { return item.FrozenRequirements[i].ID < item.FrozenRequirements[j].ID })
	}
	for i := range canonical.CourseBindings {
		b := &canonical.CourseBindings[i]
		sortHybridTargets(b.LearningTargets)
		b.OpenedAt = time.Time{}
		b.ClosedAt = nil
	}
	for i := range canonical.PracticeBindings {
		sortHybridTargets(canonical.PracticeBindings[i].LearningTargets)
	}
	for i := range canonical.Mastery {
		canonical.Mastery[i].LastSeenAt = nil
		canonical.Mastery[i].LastPracticedAt = nil
		canonical.Mastery[i].LastFailedAt = nil
	}
	refs := HybridSnapshotReferences{}
	refs.GoalRef, err = hybridSnapshotDigest(struct {
		Schema, StudentID, ProfileVersion string
		OwnerVersion                      int64
		GoalCode                          string
	}{"student-planning-goal-ref.v1", s.StudentID, canonical.Profile.ProfileVersion, canonical.Profile.OwnerVersion, canonical.Profile.GoalCode})
	if err != nil {
		return refs, err
	}
	refs.ConstraintsRef, err = hybridSnapshotDigest(struct {
		Schema, StudentID, ProfileVersion string
		OwnerVersion                      int64
		Language                          string
		WeeklyMinutes                     int
		Pace                              string
	}{"student-planning-constraints-ref.v1", s.StudentID, canonical.Profile.ProfileVersion, canonical.Profile.OwnerVersion, canonical.Profile.PreferredLanguage, canonical.Profile.WeeklyMinutes, canonical.Profile.PreferredPace})
	if err != nil {
		return refs, err
	}
	refs.LearnerRef, err = hybridSnapshotDigest(struct {
		Schema, StudentID string
		Profile           HybridSnapshotProfile
		Path              HybridSnapshotPath
		ActivityFacts     []HybridSnapshotActivityFact
		CourseBindings    []HybridCourseActionBinding
		PracticeBindings  []HybridPracticeBinding
		Availability      HybridSnapshotAvailability
		PendingIntent     *HybridLearningIntentProjection `json:"pending_intent,omitempty"`
	}{"student-learner-planning-ref.v1", s.StudentID, canonical.Profile, canonical.Path, canonical.ActivityFacts, canonical.CourseBindings, canonical.PracticeBindings, canonical.Availability, canonical.PendingIntent})
	if err != nil {
		return refs, err
	}
	refs.MasteryRef, err = hybridSnapshotDigest(struct {
		Schema, StudentID string
		Targets           []HybridTargetRef
		Mastery           []HybridSnapshotMastery
		Evidence          []HybridEvidenceReference
	}{"student-planning-mastery-ref.v1", s.StudentID, canonical.RequestedTargets, canonical.Mastery, canonical.Evidence})
	if err != nil {
		return refs, err
	}
	refs.SnapshotRef, err = hybridSnapshotDigest(struct {
		Schema, StudentID, PathID string
		Targets                   []HybridTargetRef
		References                HybridSnapshotReferences
	}{HybridSnapshotSchema, s.StudentID, s.LearningPathID, canonical.RequestedTargets, refs})
	return refs, err
}
func sortHybridTargets(targets []HybridTargetRef) {
	sort.Slice(targets, func(i, j int) bool { return hybridTargetIdentity(targets[i]) < hybridTargetIdentity(targets[j]) })
}
func sortHybridCollections(s *HybridPlanningSnapshot) {
	sort.Slice(s.Evidence, func(i, j int) bool {
		a, b := s.Evidence[i], s.Evidence[j]
		return a.SourceKind+"\x00"+a.EvidenceID+"\x00"+hybridTargetIdentity(a.Target) < b.SourceKind+"\x00"+b.EvidenceID+"\x00"+hybridTargetIdentity(b.Target)
	})
	sort.Slice(s.ActivityFacts, func(i, j int) bool {
		a, b := s.ActivityFacts[i], s.ActivityFacts[j]
		return a.Type+"\x00"+a.FactID < b.Type+"\x00"+b.FactID
	})
	sort.Slice(s.CourseBindings, func(i, j int) bool {
		return s.CourseBindings[i].LearningActionID < s.CourseBindings[j].LearningActionID
	})
	sort.Slice(s.PracticeBindings, func(i, j int) bool {
		return s.PracticeBindings[i].TaskInstanceID < s.PracticeBindings[j].TaskInstanceID
	})
}
func hybridSnapshotDigest(value any) (string, error) {
	raw, err := json.Marshal(value)
	if err != nil || len(raw) > MaximumHybridSnapshotResponseBytes {
		return "", ErrValidation
	}
	sum := sha256.Sum256(raw)
	return "sha256:" + hex.EncodeToString(sum[:]), nil
}

func normalizeHybridSnapshotEvidence(e HybridEvidenceReference, allowed map[string]bool) (HybridEvidenceReference, error) {
	t, err := normalizeHybridTarget(e.Target)
	e.Target = t
	expected, kindErr := hybridEvidenceKind(e.EvidenceClass, e.Outcome, e.SupportContext)
	if err != nil || !allowed[hybridTargetIdentity(t)] || !hybridUUID(e.EvidenceID) || kindErr != nil || e.Kind != expected || e.OccurredAt.IsZero() || !hybridLearningValue(e.TeacherPolicyVersion, 64) || e.MasteryPolicyVersion != StudentMasteryPolicyVersion || e.HintsUsed < 0 || e.HintsUsed > 1000 || (e.HintsUsed == 0) != (e.MaxHintLevel == nil) || (e.MaxHintLevel != nil && (*e.MaxHintLevel < 0 || *e.MaxHintLevel > 7)) {
		return HybridEvidenceReference{}, ErrValidation
	}
	if e.SupportContext == "independent" && (e.HintsUsed != 0 || e.InterventionUsed) {
		return HybridEvidenceReference{}, ErrValidation
	}
	switch e.SourceKind {
	case "course_answer":
		if e.LearningActionID != e.EvidenceID || !hybridUUID(e.TaskID) || e.TaskInstanceID != "" || e.TaskRevisionID != "" || e.SubmissionID != "" || e.ReceiptHash != "" || e.SurfaceClassification != "" {
			return HybridEvidenceReference{}, ErrValidation
		}
	case "practice_v2", "practice_legacy":
		if e.SurfaceClassification != "" && e.SurfaceClassification != "practice" && e.SurfaceClassification != "project" {
			return HybridEvidenceReference{}, ErrValidation
		}
		if e.SourceKind == "practice_legacy" && e.SurfaceClassification != "" {
			return HybridEvidenceReference{}, ErrValidation
		}
		if !hybridUUID(e.TaskInstanceID) || !hybridUUID(e.TaskRevisionID) || e.SubmissionID != e.EvidenceID || !hybridDigest(e.ReceiptHash) || e.EvidenceClass != "application" || e.Outcome != "passed" || (e.TaskID != "" && e.TaskID != e.TaskInstanceID) {
			return HybridEvidenceReference{}, ErrValidation
		}
		if e.SourceKind == "practice_v2" && !hybridUUID(e.LearningActionID) || e.SourceKind == "practice_legacy" && e.LearningActionID != "" {
			return HybridEvidenceReference{}, ErrValidation
		}
	default:
		return HybridEvidenceReference{}, ErrValidation
	}
	e.OccurredAt = e.OccurredAt.UTC()
	if e.MaxHintLevel != nil {
		v := *e.MaxHintLevel
		e.MaxHintLevel = &v
	}
	return e, nil
}
func hybridRequirement(items []HybridSnapshotItem, itemID, requirementID string) (HybridLessonRequirement, bool) {
	for _, item := range items {
		if item.ID == itemID {
			for _, r := range item.FrozenRequirements {
				if r.ID == requirementID {
					return r, true
				}
			}
		}
	}
	return HybridLessonRequirement{}, false
}
func validateHybridCourseBinding(b HybridCourseActionBinding, items []HybridSnapshotItem) error {
	if !hybridUUID(b.LearningActionID) || !hybridUUID(b.AnswerID) || !hybridUUID(b.TaskID) || b.OpenedAt.IsZero() || b.AnswerStatus < 1 || b.AnswerStatus > 5 {
		return ErrValidation
	}
	if b.LifecycleStatus == "OPEN" {
		if b.ClosedAt != nil {
			return ErrValidation
		}
	} else if b.LifecycleStatus == "CLOSED" {
		if b.ClosedAt == nil || b.ClosedAt.IsZero() || b.ClosedAt.Before(b.OpenedAt) {
			return ErrValidation
		}
	} else {
		return ErrValidation
	}
	refs, err := normalizeHybridTargets(b.LearningTargets)
	if err != nil || !hybridCanonicalEqual(refs, b.LearningTargets) {
		return ErrValidation
	}
	requirement, found := hybridRequirement(items, b.LearningPathItemID, b.RequirementID)
	if !found || (requirement.Type != "quiz_passed" && requirement.Type != "task_passed") || requirement.SourceReference.ID != b.TaskID {
		return ErrValidation
	}
	return nil
}
func validateHybridPracticeBinding(b HybridPracticeBinding, path HybridSnapshotPath) error {
	if !hybridUUID(b.LearningActionID) || !hybridUUID(b.TaskInstanceID) || !hybridUUID(b.TaskRevisionID) || !hybridDigest(b.TaskRevisionDigest) || b.LearningPathID != path.ID || b.LearningPathVersionReservation < 1 || b.LearningPathVersionReservation > path.Version || b.LearningPathPositionReservation < 0 || (b.SurfaceClassification != "practice" && b.SurfaceClassification != "project") {
		return ErrValidation
	}
	switch b.LifecycleStatus {
	case "RESERVED", "OPEN", "CANCELLED", "CLOSED":
	default:
		return ErrValidation
	}
	refs, err := normalizeHybridTargets(b.LearningTargets)
	if err != nil || len(refs) == 0 {
		return ErrValidation
	}
	for _, t := range refs {
		if t.Version == "" {
			return ErrValidation
		}
	}
	if b.LearningPathItemID != "" || b.RequirementID != "" {
		r, ok := hybridRequirement(path.Items, b.LearningPathItemID, b.RequirementID)
		if !ok || r.Type != "practice_completed" || r.SourceReference.ID != b.TaskRevisionID || r.SourceReference.RevisionID != b.TaskRevisionID {
			return ErrValidation
		}
	} else {
		found := false
		for _, item := range path.Items {
			if item.ReferenceType == "practice" && item.ReferenceID == b.TaskRevisionID {
				found = true
			}
		}
		if !found {
			return ErrValidation
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func hybridLearningValue(v string, max int) bool {
	return strings.TrimSpace(v) != "" && len(v) <= max && utf8.ValidString(v)
}
func normalizeHybridTarget(t HybridTargetRef) (HybridTargetRef, error) {
	if !hybridTargetValid(t) {
		return HybridTargetRef{}, ErrValidation
	}
	return t, nil
}
func normalizeHybridTargets(in []HybridTargetRef) ([]HybridTargetRef, error) {
	if len(in) > 100 {
		return nil, ErrValidation
	}
	out := make([]HybridTargetRef, len(in))
	seen := map[string]bool{}
	for i, t := range in {
		if !hybridTargetValid(t) || seen[hybridTargetIdentity(t)] {
			return nil, ErrValidation
		}
		seen[hybridTargetIdentity(t)] = true
		out[i] = t
	}
	return out, nil
}
func hybridCanonicalEqual(a, b any) bool {
	x, e := json.Marshal(a)
	y, f := json.Marshal(b)
	return e == nil && f == nil && string(x) == string(y)
}
func hybridEvidenceKind(class, outcome, support string) (string, error) {
	if (class != "application" && class != "knowledge_check") || (outcome != "passed" && outcome != "failed") || (support != "independent" && support != "guided") {
		return "", ErrValidation
	}
	if class == "knowledge_check" {
		if outcome == "failed" {
			return "failed_knowledge_check", nil
		}
		if support == "independent" {
			return "independent_understanding", nil
		}
		return "assisted_understanding", nil
	}
	if outcome == "failed" {
		return "failed_application", nil
	}
	if support == "independent" {
		return "independent_application", nil
	}
	return "assisted_application", nil
}
func validateHybridLessonAssignment(item HybridSnapshotItem) error {
	if item.LessonRevisionID == "" {
		if len(item.FrozenRequirements) != 0 {
			return ErrValidation
		}
		return nil
	}
	if item.ReferenceType != "lesson" || !hybridUUID(item.ID) || !hybridUUID(item.LessonRevisionID) || len(item.FrozenRequirements) < 1 || len(item.FrozenRequirements) > 500 {
		return ErrValidation
	}
	seen := map[string]bool{}
	required := false
	for _, r := range item.FrozenRequirements {
		if !hybridUUID(r.ID) || !hybridUUID(r.ActivityID) || seen[r.ID] || !hybridUUID(r.SourceReference.ID) {
			return ErrValidation
		}
		seen[r.ID] = true
		switch r.Type {
		case "theory_acknowledged":
		case "quiz_passed", "task_passed", "practice_completed":
			if !hybridUUID(r.SourceReference.RevisionID) {
				return ErrValidation
			}
		default:
			return ErrValidation
		}
		required = required || r.Required
	}
	if !required {
		return ErrValidation
	}
	return nil
}
func validateHybridOwnerSemantics(s HybridPlanningSnapshot) error {
	request, e := NormalizeHybridSnapshotRequest(HybridSnapshotRequest{Targets: s.RequestedTargets, TriggerContext: s.TriggerContext})
	if e != nil || !reflect.DeepEqual(request.Targets, s.RequestedTargets) {
		return ErrValidation
	}
	p, e := NormalizeStudentPlanningProfile(StudentPlanningProfile{DirectionCode: s.Profile.DirectionCode, SelfAssessedExperience: s.Profile.SelfAssessedExperience, KnownStacks: s.Profile.KnownStacks, DesiredStacks: s.Profile.DesiredStacks, GoalCode: s.Profile.GoalCode, PreferredLanguage: s.Profile.PreferredLanguage, WeeklyMinutes: s.Profile.WeeklyMinutes, PreferredPace: s.Profile.PreferredPace, ProfileVersion: s.Profile.ProfileVersion})
	if e != nil || p.DirectionCode != s.Profile.DirectionCode || p.SelfAssessedExperience != s.Profile.SelfAssessedExperience || p.GoalCode != s.Profile.GoalCode || p.PreferredLanguage != s.Profile.PreferredLanguage || p.PreferredPace != s.Profile.PreferredPace || !reflect.DeepEqual(p.KnownStacks, s.Profile.KnownStacks) || !reflect.DeepEqual(p.DesiredStacks, s.Profile.DesiredStacks) {
		return ErrValidation
	}
	if (s.Path.IsPrimary && s.Path.Status != "ACTIVE") || len(s.Path.GoalCode) > 64 || len(s.Path.CourseFingerprint) > 128 || len(s.Path.PlannerPolicyVersion) > 64 {
		return ErrValidation
	}
	for _, item := range s.Path.Items {
		targets, e := normalizeHybridTargets(item.Targets)
		if e != nil || !hybridCanonicalEqual(targets, item.Targets) || validateHybridLessonAssignment(item) != nil {
			return ErrValidation
		}
	}
	allowed := map[string]bool{}
	for _, m := range s.Mastery {
		allowed[hybridTargetIdentity(m.Target)] = true
		for _, v := range []*time.Time{m.LastSeenAt, m.LastPracticedAt, m.LastFailedAt} {
			if v != nil && v.IsZero() {
				return ErrValidation
			}
		}
	}
	evidenceKeys := map[string]bool{}
	for _, e := range s.Evidence {
		_, err := normalizeHybridSnapshotEvidence(e, allowed)
		key := e.SourceKind + "\x00" + e.EvidenceID + "\x00" + hybridTargetIdentity(e.Target)
		if err != nil || (e.StudentID != "" && e.StudentID != s.StudentID) || evidenceKeys[key] {
			return ErrValidation
		}
		evidenceKeys[key] = true
	}
	factKeys := map[string]bool{}
	for _, f := range s.ActivityFacts {
		r, ok := hybridRequirement(s.Path.Items, f.ItemID, f.RequirementID)
		key := f.Type + "\x00" + f.FactID
		if !ok || !r.Satisfied || f.Type != r.Type || f.SourceID != r.SourceReference.ID || f.SourceRevisionID != r.SourceReference.RevisionID || !hybridUUID(f.FactID) || f.OccurredAt.IsZero() || factKeys[key] {
			return ErrValidation
		}
		factKeys[key] = true
	}
	courseKeys := map[string]bool{}
	for _, b := range s.CourseBindings {
		if (b.StudentID != "" && b.StudentID != s.StudentID) || validateHybridCourseBinding(b, s.Path.Items) != nil || courseKeys[b.LearningActionID] {
			return ErrValidation
		}
		courseKeys[b.LearningActionID] = true
	}
	practiceKeys := map[string]bool{}
	for _, b := range s.PracticeBindings {
		if validateHybridPracticeBinding(b, s.Path) != nil || practiceKeys[b.TaskInstanceID] {
			return ErrValidation
		}
		practiceKeys[b.TaskInstanceID] = true
	}
	for _, entry := range []struct {
		signal HybridSnapshotSignal
		reason string
	}{{s.Availability.RuntimeHold, "RUNTIME_HOLD_NOT_OBSERVED"}, {s.Availability.AutomaticAdaptation, "AUTOMATIC_ADAPTATION_NOT_DEFINED"}, {s.Availability.StudentPinning, "STUDENT_PINNING_NOT_DEFINED"}} {
		if entry.signal.Status != "UNAVAILABLE" || entry.signal.Value != nil || entry.signal.ReasonCode != entry.reason {
			return ErrValidation
		}
	}
	return nil
}
